decision: NO_CHANGE. The two observed native tests reproduce neither duplicate query keys nor a wrong campaign/group/localized destination; preserve the existing account automatic-tagging settings, manual suffixes and legacy campaign settings. Use the observed automatic campaign/group mapping for measurement qualification.
critical_challenge: A possible coexistence problem described in documentation is not a reproduced defect. Removing two suffixes or changing account tagging lacks a demonstrated correction benefit in these tests.
unsupported_counterfactual_rationales_no: The frozen alternatives state suffix-clearing Saves would cause new editorial review. These receipts do not establish that consequence; it is unnecessary to the NO_CHANGE decision.
provenance_limits: Root operated native Test and transcribed the rendered result. Reviewer independently decoded the two saved URL strings and compared entity identities and frozen sources; no independent live replay occurred.
Test placeholders msclkid=123abc and utm_term=keyword are not genuine visitor/click/keyword evidence.
Landing page found establishes only this native test result; no full ad editorial approval, user-visible storefront flow, consent fix, GA4 ingestion, purchase/order join or performance is inferred.
The tested query mapping is not a guarantee for every keyword, device, redirect or placement, and the saved-source comparison is not a claim that frozen strings themselves are runtime authority.
No fresh readback of all legacy campaigns was performed in this lane; preserving them is the no-mutation scope, not a new exhaustive account audit.
